Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # anchor = color of the longer total run length among multi-cell straight segments
    def seglen(c):
        tot=0
        seen=set()
        for i in range(h):
            j=0
            while j<w:
                if g[i][j]==c:
                    k=j
                    while k<w and g[i][k]==c: k+=1
                    tot+=max(k-j,1)
                    j=k
                else: j+=1
        for j in range(w):
            i=0
            while i<h:
                if g[i][j]==c:
                    k=i
                    while k<h and g[k][j]==c: k+=1
                    tot+=max(k-i,1); i=k
                else: i+=1
        return tot
    anc=max(others,key=seglen)
    mk=[c for c in others if c!=anc][0]
    acr=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==anc]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in acr); r1=max(i for i,_ in acr)
    c0=min(j for _,j in acr); c1=max(j for _,j in acr)
    out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if g[i][j]==anc: continue
            if g[i][j]==mk: out[i][j]=4
            else: out[i][j]=mk
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

data=[]

    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    items=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    emit=min(items,key=lambda c:sum(1 for r in gi for v in r if v==c))
    tgt=[c for c in items if c!=emit][0]
    segs=runs(gi,emit)
    for seg in segs:
        typ,pos,a,b=seg
        for rp in endpoints(seg):

            rr=rp[0] if typ=='v' else rp[1]
            fired=False; stopped=None
            # simulate ray
            steps=0
            R,C=(rr+ (1 if typ=='h' else 0), cc+(1 if typ=='v' else 0))

G=load()
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def bars(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # runs
    out=[]
    for col,count in sorted(c.items()):
        if col==bg: continue
        segs=[]
        for i in range(h):
            j=0
            while j<w:
                if g[i][j]==col:
                    k=j
                    while k<w and g[i][k]==col: k+=1
                    if k-j>1: segs.append((i,j,k-1))
                    j=k
                else: j+=1
        if segs: out.append((col,segs,'h'))
    return bg,out
for n in range(1,6):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']
    bg,bars=bars(gi)
    c=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    others=[k for k in c if k!=bg]
    mk=min(others,key=lambda k:c[k])
    em=[k for k in others if k!=mk][0]
    mb=[(i,j) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==mk]

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # seed color: rarest non-bg? find colors != bg
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # bar cells: contiguous structures; seeds: isolated single cells
    # heuristics: seed color = color whose cells all have <=4 neighbors of same color
    seed=None; bar=None
    for c in others:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        maxconn=max(sum((i==a and j==b) or (i==b and j==a) for a,b in cells) for i,j in cells)
        if maxconn<=4 and len(cells)<=6: seed=c
        else: bar=c
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==seed]
    bcells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==bar]
    rowsB=sorted(set(i for i,j in bcells)); colsB=sorted(set(j for i,j in bcells))
    horiz = len(rowsB)<len(colsB)  # bars run horizontally -> vertical stripes
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,j in seeds: out[i][j]=4
    if horiz:
        # spans: minimal contiguous ranges covering bar rows
        def spans(cells):
            s=set()
            cur=[]
            for c in sorted(set(i for i,_ in cells)):
                if cur and abs(c-cur[-1])==1: cur.append(c)
                else: s.add((cur[0],cur[-1])); cur=[c]
            if cur: s.add((cur[0],cur[-1]))
            return s
        SB=list(spans(bcells))[0]; OB=list(spans([(i,j) for i,j in bcells if i!=SB[0]])[0]) if any(i!=SB[0] for i,j in bcells) else list(spans(bcells))[1:]
        S0,S1=min(SB),max(SB); O0,O1=min(OB),max(OB)
        d=S1-O1  # translate seed pos rel to own span -> other span
        for i,j in seeds:
            if not (S0<=j<=S1): continue
            jj=j+d
            if O0<=jj<=O1:
                for k in range(H):
                    v=g[k][jj]
                    if v==bg: out[k][jj]=seed
    else:
        def spans(cells):
            s=set(); cur=[]
            for r in sorted(set(j for _,j in cells)):
                if cur and abs(r-cur[-1])==1: cur.append(r)
                else: s.add((cur[0],cur[-1])); cur=[r]
            if cur: s.add((cur[0],cur[-1]))
            return s
        SB=list(spans(bcells))[0]; OB=list(spans(bcells)[1:])
        if not OB: OB=[(min(SB),min(SB))]  # fallback
        S0,S1=min(SB),max(SB); O0,O1=min(OB),max(OB)
        d=S1-O1
        for i,j in seeds:
            if not (O0<=i<=O1): continue
            ii=i+d
            if S0<=ii<=S1:
                for k in range(W):
                    v=g[ii][k]
                    if v==bg: out[ii][k]=seed
    return out

from collections import Counter
def info(p):
    g=G2[f'Demo pair {p} input']; o=G2[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # bar color: forms long straight runs (>=3 contiguous); stray color: single cells, unique
    barc=None; strc=None
    best=None
    for c,n in cnt.items():
        if n==1: continue
        runs=[]
        # horizontal runs
        for j in range(W):
            k=j
            while k<W and g[j][k]==c: k+=1
            if k-j>=3: runs.append(('h',j,k-1))
        for i in range(H):
            k=i
            while k<H and g[k][j]==c: k+=1
            if k-i>=3: runs.append(('v',i,k-1))
        if runs:
            if best is None or len(runs)>len(best[1][1]):
                best=(c,runs)
    barc=best[0]; bruns=best[1]

steps.input:
for i in [1,2,3,5,6,7,8]:
    gi=D[f'Demo pair {i} input']; go=D[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    print('=== demo',i)
    # non-bg colors
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pcs=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=bg and cnt[gi[r][c]]>=2]
    sing=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=bg and cnt[gi[r][c]==0] or (gi[r][c]!=bg and cnt[gi[r][c]]==1)]
    sing=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=bg and cnt[gi[r][c]]==1]
    chg=[(r,c,gi[r][c],go[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]]
    print(' bg=',bg,'pieces',pcs,'singles',sing)
    print(' changes:',chg)

            v=O[rr][cc]
